feature: HM-516 — Authored posts view and CSV export

scenarios.title: Retrieve authored posts for the current user
scenarios.preconditions: User is authenticated with a valid bearer token
scenarios.steps:
Given the authenticated user requests /v1/users/posts
When the authored posts endpoint returns data
Then the response status should be 200
And the response body should contain only posts authored by the current user
scenarios.expected_result: Authenticated user receives a list of authored posts with id, title, and created_at fields

scenarios.title: Export authored posts to CSV
scenarios.preconditions: User is authenticated and has authored posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user requests /v1/users/posts/export?format=csv
When the CSV export endpoint returns data
Then the response status should be 200
And the response content type should be text/csv
scenarios.expected_result: A valid CSV file is returned containing authored post rows
edge_cases: CSV file contains only current user's posts

scenarios.title: Unauthenticated access to authored posts is blocked
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is not authenticated
When the user requests /v1/users/posts
Then the response status should be 401
scenarios.expected_result: Unauthenticated requests are rejected with 401 Unauthorized

scenarios.title: No authored posts returns an empty list
scenarios.preconditions: Authenticated user has no authored posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user has no authored posts
When the user requests /v1/users/posts
Then the response status should be 200
And the response body should contain an empty list
scenarios.expected_result: The authored posts endpoint returns an empty array instead of null

scenarios.title: CSV export includes required post columns
scenarios.steps:
Given the user requests /v1/users/posts/export?format=csv
When the CSV response is returned
Then the first row should contain id,title,created_at,status
scenarios.expected_result: The CSV file contains the expected header columns for authored posts

scenarios.title: My Posts page displays only authored posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user navigates to the My Posts page
When the page loads
Then the authored posts list is displayed
And each post card shows title, created date and status
scenarios.expected_result: The page shows only posts authored by the logged-in user
edge_cases: Authored posts list contains no posts

scenarios.title: Export to CSV downloads authored posts report
scenarios.preconditions: User is logged in and has authored posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the My Posts page
When the user clicks the Export CSV button
Then the browser downloads a .csv file
And the downloaded file contains authored post rows
scenarios.expected_result: A CSV file download is triggered for the user's authored posts
edge_cases: Download fails due to network error

scenarios.title: Empty authored posts shows placeholder and disables export
scenarios.preconditions: Authenticated user has no authored posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the My Posts page
When the page loads
Then the empty state message is visible
And the Export CSV button is disabled
scenarios.expected_result: The UI shows a clear empty state and prevents exporting no data

coverage_summary: Covers authenticated authored post listing, CSV export, unauthenticated access, and empty-state behavior.
uncovered_requirements: Exact author verification in post list
